ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A certain way in which a CD drive reads data can be simplified as the following model: when reading data on the inner ring, it reads by means of constant angular velocity, while when reading data on the outer ring, it reads by means of constant linear velocity. As shown in the figure, let the radius of the inner edge of the inner ring be R1, the radius of the outer edge of the inner ring be R2, and the radius of the outer edge of the outer ring be R3. A, B, and C are respectively points on the edge lines. Then the ratio of the magnitude of the centripetal acceleration when reading point A on the inner ring to the magnitude of the centripetal acceleration when reading point C on the outer ring is (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows a concentric circular optical-disc region; on the inner side there is an inner edge whose radius is marked as R1, the outer edge of the inner ring corresponds to radius R2, and the outer edge of the outer ring corresponds to radius R3; A, B, and C are respectively marked on the edge lines corresponding to radii R1, R2, and R3. The outer ring is read at constant linear velocity; at the junction B of the inner and outer rings, the linear velocity is v=ωR2, so when reading point C, the centripetal acceleration is a_C=v^2/R3=(ωR2)^2/R3=ω^2R2^2/R3. Therefore a_A:a_C=(ω^2R1):(ω^2R2^2/R3)=R1R3/R2^2.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中是同心圆光盘区域，内环从半径 R1 的内边缘到半径 R2 的外边缘，外环从半径 R2 延伸到半径 R3；A 在半径 R1 的边缘线上，B 在半径 R2 的分界边缘线上，C 在半径 R3 的外边缘线上。再读题：内环用恒定角速度读取，外环用恒定线速度读取。设内环恒定角速度为 ω，则读 A 点时向心加速度 a_A=ω^2 R1。由于 B 是内外环交界处，外环恒定线速度应等于在 B 处接续读取的线速度 v=ωR2，所以读 C 点时 a_C=v^2/R3=ω^2 R2^2/R3。最后取比值 a_A/a_C=(ω^2R1)/(ω^2R2^2/R3)=R1R3/R2^2。
